title: Similar | Demo Request Constraint Digest
goal: Read inbound product demo request emails and extract each requester’s scheduling constraints into `/root/demo_request_constraints.json`, including acceptable date ranges, preferred time windows, explicit blackout periods, timezone references, and requested session duration.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the original email-scheduling domain and tests the skill’s core job: turning messy meeting-request prose into structured scheduling constraints, without reusing the original calendar-reply workflow.
